items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Jack McVay had a band that he was working in a place

ctx.x: Yeah. I had still -- I had the little band I was telling you about, and I went up to San Francisco, and I was working in a club up there called the California Club, and right around the corner, Jack McVay had a band that he was working in a place -- I don't recall the name of it, but you know, that's where Vernon Alley -- you know, the bass player -- was from up there.
